question: Under what condition is beast-hood said to arise for one addressed as goddess and lady of the gods?
premises: One is addressed as goddess and lady of the gods.
That one is described as conditioned by ignorance.
Beast-hood is said to be attained in that condition.
inference: Conditioned by ignorance, one attains beast-hood.
uncertainties: Whether this is a general claim or addressed to a specific case remains unclear.
plain_english: O goddess, O lady of the gods, conditioned by ignorance one attains beast-hood.
